about: Whether a feature is free for the caller. With NAME: `feature` is the name, `answer` is yours (the caller leads it), free (no lead) or free-stale (the lead's lease is stale: `lead` holds that lead), `warnings` are the sentences the text form prints on standard error, and `features` is absent. Without NAME: `feature` and `answer` are null, `lead` is null, `warnings` is empty, and `features` holds one row for each open feature with its own `warnings`. A feature held by another live lead is not an answer: the verb exits 1 with a qargi-refusal line on standard error and no document, and a remote that cannot be asked (without --assume-unreachable-ok) exits 3 the same way. `remote` and `backend` are as in qargi-marshal-status: with --assume-unreachable-ok and a remote that cannot be reached the verb exits 0 from the cache and `remote` is unchecked. `lease` and `minutes_since_renewal` of a row mean what `lease_clock` says, as in qargi-marshal-status.
writes: On the local backend a record whose branch is gone is marked abandoned. On the shared refs backend it fetches the shared records into this machine's cache and updates this machine's own observation cache and, with integrity on, its acceptance marks. With --assume-unreachable-ok it appends one audit line. The shared records are never changed.

backend.description: Where the records live: this host's files or the shared refs of the project's remote.

remote.description: Whether the answer was checked against the remote of the shared records.

feature.description: The feature asked about; null when no NAME was given.

answer.description: null when no NAME was given.

lead.description: The stale lead when the answer is free-stale; null otherwise.

warnings.description: Sentences for a person; empty when no NAME was given (each row of `features` has its own).

features.x-when: No NAME was given: one row for each open feature.

worktree.x-when: The lead record names its work tree (a digest of its path).

succeeds.x-when: The lead took over as the successor of an earlier lead of the same host, user and work tree.

status.description: unled: the feature has a branch and no record.

lease.description: none: the feature has no lead.

minutes_since_renewal.description: Whole minutes; null when the feature has no lead or the age is unknown.

renewed_at.description: The time of the last renewal as the record holds it; null when it was never renewed.

branch.description: The branch feature/NAME exists in this repository.

ghost.description: The record is abandoned and its branch is gone.

warnings.description: The sentences the text form prints on standard error for this feature.

provisional.x-when: Shared refs backend: true while a claim has not reached the remote.

integrity.x-when: The project's integrity setting is not off.

integrity_note.x-when: The project's integrity setting is not off.

signer.x-when: The project's integrity setting is not off; empty when the record is not signed.
